translation_notes: the first g.add() quadruple shares subject c across rdf:type, skos:prefLabel, skos:definition, skos:inScheme: translated as a single +{ } with ';'-separated predicate-object pairs, per the add_run_shared_subject construction.

the two loops each add exactly one triple per iteration on the same subject c but with a per-iteration predicate/object pair chosen by an if/else on the value shape (IRI vs literal): kept as one +{ } per branch rather than merged, since predicate and object differ per call and there is nothing shared to factor with ';'.

g.bind(...) calls (including the dynamic '' and 'cs' prefixes) are namespace-manager bindings on runtime-computed values, not @prefix declarations resolvable at transpile time, so they are left as plain rdflib calls.

driver re-parses each side's serialised Turtle response body into a fresh Graph and compares those by isomorphism, instead of comparing the Flask Response objects/bytes directly, since raw serialisation order and Response identity are not a valid oracle.
context shim vocprez/_config.py added to bind DEFAULT_LANGUAGE, mirroring vocprez/_config/template.py at the pinned commit.

Credit correction (2026-11-02, corpus/403 defect 3): dropped `@prefix` for `dcterms:`, `rdf:`, `rdfs:`, declared by the mechanical draft but never used as a term in the translated region (and not among the bindings the original sets on its graph); `rdfeval check` stays OK.

repair.credit: unused prefix declarations dropped from translated.ldpy

optimization_notes: optimized.py: `concept = self.concept` once; the two identical double loops (related_instances values, other_properties) become one loop over `[*(… or {}).values(), *(… or [])]` (the `is not None` guards keep their effect: None contributes nothing); the if/else on the value shape becomes a conditional expression feeding one add; the four exploded `g.add((\n c,\n …))` blocks become one-line adds; `"/".join(str(c).split("/")[:-1]) + "/"` becomes `str(c).rpartition("/")[0] + "/"` (identical, slash or not); the serialise if/else becomes `is_json` + one serialize call; Response on one line.

optimized.ldpy, from optimized.py: `@graph as g` (g.bind calls kept, runtime prefixes); URIRef(…) becomes f<{…}>; the four Concept triples become one `+{ {c} a skos:Concept ; skos:prefLabel {…}@{lang} ; skos:definition {…}@{lang} ; skos:inScheme {cs} }` (shared subject, island only; Literal(x, lang=…) becomes `{x}@{config.DEFAULT_LANGUAGE}`, transpiled to Literal(x, lang=langtag(...))); the loop's value becomes `f<{prop.value}> if … else ?{prop.value}` and the add `+{ {c} f<{prop.uri}> {value} }`.
Symmetry: outside the RDF lines the two files are identical line for line.
